memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin D deficiency.
Patient reports fatigue and mild bilateral knee aches over past month. Examination shows normal vitals, no joint swelling or deformities. Smoking status: never. Plan: start high-dose cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU daily, recheck labs in 2 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then cholecalciferol 1000 IU oral daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D: 12 ng/mL (ref 20-50). Serum calcium: 9.2 mg/dL (ref 8.5-10.5). Serum phosphate: 3.8 mg/dL (ref 2.5-4.5).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin D deficiency, responding to therapy.
Fatigue improved, no bone pain. Examination unchanged. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique not applicable. Spirometry not indicated. Plan: continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD, repeat labs today.
